samples.label: sample-01

samples.label: sample-04

comparisonVerdict.rationale: The two active and completion samples trade strengths; average visual scores are equal, with one sample strongest on route readability and the other strongest on completion polish.

biggestGaps: The evidence is inconsistent: completion frames omit core route elements, while only one frame clearly exposes the full challenge set including a hazard.
